**Job Description**

About Teleradiology Solutions

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round-the-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and technology-driven healthcare solutions across India, the US and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians, TRS serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.

With its AI-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, the company is expanding its capabilities in healthcare technology, AI and medical imaging innovation.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter with mandatory Healthcare IT / HealthTech recruitment experience to join our Talent Acquisition team.

The ideal candidate must have a proven track record of hiring for healthcare technology positions, along with experience recruiting for AI/ML, software engineering and other technical roles.

We are looking for candidates with consistent career progression, a stable employment history and the ability to manage end-to-end technical recruitment independently.

Key Responsibilities

  

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for technical and engineering positions.
* Source and recruit candidates for Healthcare IT, HealthTech, AI/ML, software development, data engineering, cloud, DevOps and other technology roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and define suitable candidate profiles.
* Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, Boolean searches, employee referrals and other sourcing channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial assessments to evaluate technical experience and suitability.
* Coordinate interviews, manage candidate communication and drive offer closures.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring requirements.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and provide regular hiring updates and reports.

### **Requirements**

Mandatory Requirements

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* 4 plus years of experience in technical recruitment.
* Mandatory hands-on experience recruiting for Healthcare IT / HealthTech / Healthcare Technology positions.
* Candidates with general IT recruitment experience but no healthcare technology hiring exposure will not be considered.
* Proven experience hiring for AI/ML, software engineering and other technical positions.
* Good understanding of technical skills, technology stacks and AI/ML job requirements.
* Strong experience with LinkedIn sourcing, Boolean search and other recruitment channels.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
* Consistent employment history and reasonable tenure across previous organizations. Frequent job changes or unexplained short tenures will be carefully evaluated.

Preferred Skills

  

* Experience working in healthcare technology, product-based companies or IT services organizations.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms such as Zoho Recruit, Greenhouse or Lever.
* Ability to manage multiple technical requirements and deliver within defined timelines.
* Strong candidate engagement and relationship-building skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

**Corporate Secretary:** Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

**Accounting & Bookkeeping:** Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

**FinTech payments:** Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist** who is excited to be the ‘face of Sleek’—partnering with business leadership to attract and close exceptional talent across the region to drive our next phase of growth.  
  
Based in Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, India, or the Philippines this role reports directly to the Country Manager of Hong Kong, with a dotted line to the Head of Talent Acquisition.

**Key outcomes in the first 6-12 months:**

**Candidate quality & delivery**

* Bring in exceptional talent who are excited about Sleek and are a great fit for our stage of growth and culture.
* Execute end-to-end candidate screening across a variety of departments, delivering high-quality shortlists that consistently achieve a minimum 80% conversion rate from TA screen to Hiring Manager interview.

**Pipeline management**

* Review incoming applications promptly to maintain fast turnaround time and keep applicants engaged.
* Demonstrate creative problem-solving in sourcing and candidate engagement to build appropriate pipeline depth within the first few weeks of a role going live.
* Proactively source candidates to ensure the top of the funnel remains strong throughout the year.

**Business Partnering**

* Proactively build and manage relationships with Sleek’s hiring managers and Leadership team, soliciting feedback and working with the Head of Talent Acquisition to prioritise that feedback.

**Process & ATS Integrity**

* Maintain up-to-date candidate data within Workable to ensure seamless tracking and reporting.
* Ensure 100% compliance with Singapore recruitment regulations (MOM, Tripartite, MCF).
* Ensure job postings are of the highest quality and meet standards set by the Talent Acquisition team.

**Requirements:**

* **Language Proficiency:**
* + **All Applicants:** Fluent professional Business English (verbal and written) is strictly required as Sleek’s primary operational language.
  + Professional proficiency in Chinese (Cantonese and/or Mandarin; written Traditional and/or Simplified) is required for candidates supporting our Hong Kong and North Asia growth pipelines.
* **Legal Work Authorization:** Must hold existing legal working rights in your country of residence (Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, India or the Philippines).
* **Workplace Arrangement:** Comfortable with the applicable local working arrangement (**Hybrid** for Singapore and Hong Kong; **Fully Remote** for Malaysia, India, or the Philippines). Candidates across all locations in Malaysia, India, and the Philippines are welcome to apply.

**Nice-to-have experience:**

* Experience in full-cycle recruitment or client-facing roles.
* Experience operating in a fast-paced startup, scale-up, or high-growth environment.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

**Attention to detail:** You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

**Excellent listener and clear communicator:** We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

**Tech + services savvy:** We are a tech-enabled services business, automating traditional, manual processes and delighting customers while doing so. You will thrive as someone who understands and is excited by the challenges and opportunities of utilising AI in this role to optimize candidate sourcing, streamline ATS workflows, and elevate overall hiring speed and quality.

**Collaboration-Driven:** You thrive in a cross-functional environment, working closely with hiring managers, department leads, and HR operations to ensure alignment on candidate profiles, hiring goals, and interview SLAs. You communicate effectively, advocate for candidate quality throughout the recruitment process, and proactively address pipeline bottlenecks before they impact hiring timelines, fostering a culture of shared accountability.

**Ownership:** This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

**Humility:** There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

**Structured thinking:** Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

### **The interview process**

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

**One-way Video Interview**

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview. This allows us to better understand your skills and experience early in the process and ensures a streamlined experience for all applicants.

**Technical Round**

A 60–90 minute interactive session with our Chief of Staff combining a background chat with a live case study. No preparation needed—we’ll explore how you tackle real-time hiring challenges.

**Soft Skills Assessment**

A ~45 minute chat with Country Manager Hong Kong, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

**Reference verification**

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

**Requirement for background screening**

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

 **Benefits**

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

**Humility and kindness:** Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility**: 3 days of work from home per week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

**Financial benefits**: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

**Personal growth**: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Teikametrics is revolutionizing retail through our patented Artificial Retail Intelligence platform. Our proprietary orchestration layer functions as prompt intelligence, verticalizing AI for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok, and emerging marketplace use cases. For more information, visit www.teikametrics.com.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Teikametrics is looking for a Product Enablement Specialist to help customers adopt ARI Catalog, our AI listing content product for Amazon and Walmart. This is a customer-facing role on the Product team, where you will join customer calls to help brands and agencies understand the product, get their content generated, reviewed, submitted and published, and drive adoption across your accounts.

You will own enablement for a set of brand and agency accounts, taking each one from setup to published content in ARI Catalog. You will also be the go-to product expert for our sales, marketing and account management teams. Along the way, you will turn what you learn from customers into product improvements and enablement content.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3–5 years of experience in ecommerce operations, catalog or listing management, product operations, or customer onboarding at a SaaS or marketplace company.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central listings, including titles, bullets, item highlights, backend keywords, variation families and common submission errors; Walmart Seller Center experience preferred.
* A strong point of view on listing content strategy for Amazon and Walmart: how titles, bullets, descriptions and keywords drive search visibility and conversion, and how to advise brands on what good content looks like.
* Strong knowledge of marketplace rules, compliance guidelines for Amazon and Walmart.
* Excellent written English and a sharp editorial eye, with the ability to tell when content/copy is accurate, on brand and not keyword stuffed.
* Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel)
* Experience with Looker or similar BI tools preferred.
* Highly organized, with the ability to run 15+ or more accounts in parallel and always know the next step and owner for each.
* Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) day to day
* Confident on customer calls, able to lead a product walkthrough, explain technical details simply and handle questions live with brands, agencies and internal teams; exposure to agencies managing multiple brand accounts preferred.
* Experience writing help center articles, training material or customer-facing templates is a plus.

  
**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* Lead customer calls to walk brands and agencies through ARI Catalog and get their content live.
* Advise brands on their Amazon and Walmart content strategy, recommending what to prioritize and how to improve their listings, not just running the tool.
* Set up each account's brand voice, required terms and rules in ARI Catalog, then use it to generate content for their products.
* Review generated content for accuracy and quality so it's ready for customer approval and submits cleanly.
* Own the path to publishing for each customer: get their approval, submit content to Amazon and Walmart, then track the results and fix any errors that come back.
* Collaborate with Amazon and Walmart partner teams and channels to troubleshoot complex issues, escalate submission blocks, and manage platform updates.
* Own tracking for every account, including rollout status, next steps, and submission and publish metrics, and report on them weekly.
* Be the go-to product expert for sales, marketing and account management.
* Share customer feedback with Product and help create help articles, templates and playbooks.

**WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED**

* Every Teikametrics employee is eligible for company equity
* Remote Work Flexibility - Work from home or from our offices, with flexible remote options
* Broadband reimbursement
* Group Medical Insurance – Coverage of INR 7,50,000 per annum for a family

title: R&D Engineer, Fluid Mechanics & Systems Modeling
description:
Energy Recovery (NASDAQ: ERII) creates technologies that solve complex challenges for industrial fluid-flow markets worldwide. Building on our pressure exchanger technology platform, we design and manufacture solutions that make industrial processes more efficient and sustainable. What began as a game-changing invention for desalination has grown into a global business advancing the environmental sustainability of customers’ operations in multiple industries. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Energy Recovery has manufacturing, research and development facilities across California and Texas with sales and on-site technical support available globally. For more information, please visit www.energyrecovery.com.

**What You Can Look Forward To:**

ERII is seeking a qualified candidate for a full-time job opening for the position of R&D Engineer, based in India and reporting to the Director, Product Design. The role will be a founding member of ERI’s India R&D team and will be remote until our India office is established. The person will work closely with a senior India-based engineer.

The R&D department is a dynamic, global group of engineers with a wide range of backgrounds, several of them holding PhD and Masters degrees. We are looking for a talented and energetic candidate who can thrive in a team environment, support R&D efforts in new technology/new product development as well as provide engineering support to enhance and expand current product lines for fluid machinery in desalination, wastewater, or other industrial processes.

The position requires a strong knowledge base in mechanics of fluids and fluid machinery. Hands-on CFD experience is required; experience with 1-D fluid system modeling is highly desirable. The candidate will spend the bulk of their time providing analytical and computational modeling support to various New Technology and New Product development projects as well as supporting validation testing, working closely with engineering teams in the US and India.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Support R&D projects (New Technology and New Product) involving fluid machines such as pressure exchangers, centrifugal and reciprocating pumps, turbines, turbochargers etc.
* Develop analytical and CFD models to analyze turbomachinery and fluid machinery designs, suggest ways to optimize designs and predict performance over the full operating envelope.

* Leverage commercial CFD tools such as ANSYS CFX/Fluent and/or STAR-CCM+ to generate computational meshes, perform CFD analyses and postprocess results.
* Build 1-D steady-state and transient fluid system models using tools such as Simscape, GT-SUITE, Simcenter Flomaster or equivalent to analyze and optimize machine and system performance.
* Help develop validation test plans and work closely with testing teams to confirm and validate model predictions. Use commercial and open-source software to process test data and draw physics-based insights and inputs for models.
* Help develop validated semi-empirical performance models of ERI products for use by engineering, sales, and customers.
* Participate in the development cycle of a fluid machine including 1-D hydraulic sizing, engineering analyses, design reviews, experimental validation, RCAs & release to manufacturing.
* Collaborate with multi-national, cross-functional teams across time zones.
* Follow ERI’s structured, phase-gated development process, contributing to design reviews and documentation at each phase.
* Contribute to the development of validated design tools and design practices.
* Other duties and projects as assigned.

### **What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (or related discipline) with 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree with 1+ years of relevant industry experience, required. Concentration in mechanics of fluids highly desirable.
* Strong background in fluid mechanics and fluid machinery required.
* Hands-on experience in commercial CFD solvers such as ANSYS CFX/Fluent or STAR-CCM+ required.
* Experience with 1-D fluid flow / system modeling tools such as Simscape, GT-SUITE or equivalent is highly desirable.
* Experience modeling turbomachinery such as pumps, turbines, compressors or fans required.
* Experience with product development of fluid machines a plus.
* Familiarity with CAD packages such as SolidWorks/Onshape/Creo/NX/CATIA and programming/scripting (Python, MATLAB) desirable.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate engineering work (e.g. research, scripting/automation, data analysis, documentation), with sound engineering judgment to verify AI-generated results, is a plus.
* Graduate-level coursework in fluid mechanics, CFD and turbomachinery highly desirable.
* Must possess a demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, manage multiple tasks, and be goal oriented.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Must be willing to work from ERI's India office once it is established; the role will be remote until then.
* Regular overlap with US Pacific time, typically 2-4 hours in the IST evening, in-office workday adjusted accordingly.
* Position may require up to 5% travel, including international travel.

*We are an EOE/AA employer committed to workforce diversity.*

*No recruiters or phone calls.*

Conducting risk-based due diligence on prospective and existing counterparties. The role evaluates counterparty identity, ownership and control, business activities, regulatory status, geographic exposure, reputation, sanctions exposure, and other financial-crime or integrity risks.

All 3rd party types

* Manages multiple cases and deadlines in a high-volume environment.
* Prioritizes higher-risk matters and time-sensitive escalations.
* Meets service-level and quality expectations with limited supervision.
* Current roles commonly require independent work, workflow tracking, periodic-review management, and timely completion of expiring records.

**Integrity and risk mindset**

* Demonstrates sound ethical judgment.
* Protects confidential information.
* Escalates concerns transparently.
* Applies policies consistently, even when business pressure exists.

**Specialist Manager, Talent Development**

**Work you'll do**

As a Specialist Manager, Talent Development on the Growth & Development team, you will be responsible for…

* Lead campus onboarding and continuous learning programs for Analyst-level professionals in USI Consulting Services, including professional and leadership learning.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, learning partners, subject matter advisors, US teams, and business stakeholders to plan, design, and deliver learning programs across USI locations.
* Build and maintain development roadmaps, curricula, and training materials; incorporate practitioner feedback, business requirements, and firmwide development frameworks.
* Direct program operations, including participant registration, facilitator onboarding and retention, train-the-trainer workshops, vendor coordination, communications, and delivery support.
* Manage learning and development investments, budgets, forecasts, spending, accruals, and reporting; track variance between reforecast and actual results.
* Use learning metrics and scorecards to assess program effectiveness, implement improvements, and lead performance management and development for team members.

**The team**

In our US India offices, the Growth & Development team supports capability development, professional networking and career progression for the region's professionals. The team specializes in connecting the dots between internal and external team members to provide a wholistic learning solution to business and come across as one.

**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 9 AM to 6 PM**

This role follows a hybrid work model: 2 days working from the office and 3 days working from home.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* Postgraduate Diploma in Training and Development (DTD) from the Indian Society for Training and Development (ISTD), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Postgraduate Diploma in Business Administration (PGDBA), or Postgraduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM).
* 10+ years of experience in growth and development or talent development roles in matrixed organizations serving international markets.
* Experience managing end-to-end training processes, including training-needs identification, learning strategy, and learning design.
* Experience leading program-management activities, including vendor management, participant processes, facilitator support, communications, and delivery.
* Experience managing cross-border stakeholder relationships and project teams, including performance management and development of team members.
* Experience managing learning and development budgets, forecasts, spending, accruals, metrics, and reporting.

Preferred:

* Experience applying Bersin’s 4E Model and the 6D Design Framework to learning-program design and delivery.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel to analyze learner data, identify performance gaps, and validate hypotheses.
* Experience using learning technologies to administer or deliver learning programs.
* Experience designing learning programs for professional and leadership development.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Manager – Manufacturing

* **Company:** Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL)
* **Location:** Vasai East, Palghar (manufacturing plant), with regular visits to our head office in Goregaon East, Mumbai
* **Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of HR experience in a manufacturing organisation (mandatory)
* **Reports to:** CEO & Director – Operations
* **Employment type:** Full-time, on-site
* **CTC:** ₹6 **– ₹9** LPA, based on experience *(fill in before posting)*

About Fluidteq Systems

Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL) is a Mumbai-based precision engineering company that makes instrumentation tube fittings, valves and manifolds. Founded in 2004, we have manufactured in-house on CNC machines since 2008.

We have supplied over 5 million fittings to Indian Railways coach and locomotive factories and to metro projects. We are an approved vendor to EIL, ONGC and ADNOC, and hold ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications. Our customers are in railways, metro, oil & gas, power and defence, in India, the UAE, Qatar, Italy and Indonesia.

We are now expanding into a new 45,000 sq ft integrated manufacturing facility, and we need an HR leader who can grow the team with it.

About the role

You will own the complete HR function — from hiring a CNC operator on Monday to closing payroll and statutory filings at month-end. This is a hands-on role in a lean, growing company: you will do the work yourself, build the systems, and be the person both employees and management trust.

Your first-year priorities: a reliable hiring pipeline for the shop floor, clean and compliant payroll, and HR practices fully aligned with India's new Labour Codes.

Key responsibilities1. Shop-floor and blue-collar hiring

* Hire CNC and VMC operators and setters, conventional machinists, QC inspectors, assembly, packing and dispatch staff, helpers and material-handling labour.
* Build steady sourcing channels: ITIs, polytechnics, local placement agencies, labour contractors, employee referrals, walk-in drives and job apps such as Apna, WorkIndia and Indeed.
* Organise practical trade tests with Production and QC — machine operation, drawing reading, and use of verniers, micrometers and gauges.
* Keep a ready pipeline of pre-screened operators so no critical machine sits idle for want of manpower.
* Run apprentice and trainee hiring under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

2. Recruitment across all levels

* Recruit for engineering, quality, production, PPC, purchase, sales and marketing, accounts and admin — from trainee to manager level.
* Write job descriptions, post on LinkedIn, Indeed and Naukri, and manage recruitment consultants.
* Screen resumes, shortlist, run telephonic and first-round interviews, and coordinate panel interviews with department heads.
* Run reference and background checks, negotiate offers, and issue offer and appointment letters.
* Track hiring metrics: time-to-fill, offer-to-join ratio, cost per hire and 90-day attrition.
* Own onboarding: joining documents, UAN and ESIC enrolment, safety induction and a first-week plan.

3. Payroll and wage administration

* Run end-to-end monthly payroll for staff and workers: biometric attendance, leave, shifts, overtime, incentives, deductions and arrears.
* Structure wages to meet the Code on Wages definition of "wages", including the 50% cap on excluded allowances.
* Apply Maharashtra minimum wages and VDA revisions on time.
* PF: monthly ECR filing, UAN and KYC upkeep, transfers and claims support — including the revised ₹25,000 EPF wage ceiling effective 17 September 2026.
* ESIC: employee registration, monthly contributions, accident reporting and benefit-claim support.
* Maharashtra Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund deductions and filings.
* Coordinate salary TDS and employee tax declarations with Accounts.
* Calculate statutory bonus, gratuity, leave encashment and overtime at twice the ordinary rate.
* Complete full-and-final settlements within the timelines set by the Code on Wages.
* Issue payslips and keep wage registers and records up to date.

4. Statutory compliance — Labour Codes and Maharashtra law

* Lead FSPL's move from the old labour laws to the four Labour Codes in force since 21 November 2025 — the Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Social Security and OSH Code — and the Central Rules notified in May 2026.
* Track Maharashtra's state rules under the Codes and update our practices as they are finalised.
* Manage factory registration and licence compliance under the OSH Code, including for our new facility, and liaise with the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH).
* Issue appointment letters to every employee, as the OSH Code requires.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and returns, digitally wherever permitted.
* Enforce working-hour, weekly-off, overtime and leave rules, and arrange annual health check-ups for eligible workers.
* Manage contract labour: verify contractors' registration, wage payments, PF and ESIC, and meet our duties as principal employer.
* Run the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, 2013: constitution, awareness training, complaint handling and the annual report.
* Set up and run a Grievance Redressal Committee as required under the Industrial Relations Code.
* Administer maternity benefit, employees' compensation and equal-pay obligations under the Codes.
* Keep the Goregaon office registered and compliant under the Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act, 2017.
* Verify age at hiring and ensure zero child or adolescent labour.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and handle labour, EPFO, ESIC and factory inspections with complete records.
* Provide HR and labour-compliance evidence for customer vendor audits and our ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 audits.

5. Employee relations, discipline and conflict

* Be the first point of contact for grievances, and resolve disputes between workers, shifts and supervisors fairly and quickly.
* Tackle absenteeism, late coming and indiscipline through counselling, warnings and documented corrective action.
* Run the disciplinary process: show-cause notices, charge sheets and domestic enquiries that follow natural justice.
* Draft, communicate and enforce HR policies and the code of conduct.
* Handle sensitive situations calmly — workplace injuries, harassment complaints, misconduct and family emergencies — working with ESIC, hospitals and families as needed.
* Manage exits: resignations, terminations, exit interviews, and relieving and experience letters.
* Keep open, regular communication with the shop floor in Marathi and Hindi.

6. Performance, training and engagement

* Run the annual appraisal cycle, with KRAs agreed with department heads.
* Maintain the operator skill matrix and training records that ISO competence requirements call for.
* Plan on-the-job, safety and multi-skilling training with Production, QC and EHS.
* Improve operator retention through attendance incentives, recognition and engagement activities.

7. HR operations and MIS

* Maintain employee files and data in our HRMS and payroll software.
* Present a monthly HR MIS to management: headcount, open positions, attrition, overtime, manpower cost and compliance status.
* Plan manpower with Production for capacity growth and the new facility.
* Coordinate HR administration: ID cards, uniforms, PPE issue records, attendance devices and service vendors.

RequirementsMust have

* Graduate in any discipline, plus an MBA/PGDM in HR, MSW, MLS or DLL&LW.
* At least 4–5 years of hands-on HR experience in a manufacturing organisation — this is mandatory.
* A proven record of hiring blue-collar staff in volume, such as CNC/VMC operators, machinists and helpers.
* Independent handling of monthly payroll, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund.
* Working knowledge of the four Labour Codes and Maharashtra labour law, with experience facing statutory inspections.
* Experience handling grievances, disciplinary action and domestic enquiries.
* Fluent in Marathi and Hindi, with good written and spoken English.
* Strong in MS Excel (lookups, pivot tables) and comfortable with payroll or HRMS software.
* Willing to be based at our Vasai East plant.

Good to have

* Experience in an engineering, machining or precision manufacturing company.
* Exposure to ISO 9001, 14001 or 45001 audits, or customer vendor audits.
* Experience setting up HR for a new plant or a growing MSME.
* Experience with contract labour, apprenticeship schemes and POSH committees.

You are

* Firm but fair — respected on the shop floor and trusted by management.
* Organised, deadline-driven and discreet with confidential data.
* Calm under pressure and comfortable having difficult conversations.

What we offer

* Full ownership of the HR function, with direct access to the CEO.
* The chance to build HR for a new 45,000 sq ft facility as we scale.
* Work with a company that supplies Indian Railways, metro projects and global oil & gas companies.
* A competitive CTC and all statutory benefits.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* HR sourcing: 4 years (Preferred)

It acts as a CX subject-matter lead and advisor, bringing consistency to enterprise CX methods while adapting priorities and recommendations to Asia Pacific market needs.

What success looks like

Leaders receive a clear, evidence-based view of customer priorities; action owners have focused and measurable plans; governance forums surface risks and decisions early; and customer insights are converted into sustained operational and commercial improvement. The CX role enables, governs, influences, and measures progress. Business, regional, and functional owners retain accountability for implementing actions and delivering business outcomes.

**Regional CX strategy and advisory**

Execute the global CX strategy across Asia Pacific PCSD and ISG, translating enterprise priorities into a focused regional agenda.
  
Act as a strategic advisor to regional and business leaders by framing customer issues, business implications, risks, and recommended decisions.
  
Identify emerging customer-experience opportunities and systemic barriers across journeys, markets, segments, and business groups.

**Voice of Customer, analytics, and insight**

Synthesize survey feedback, verbatim comments, operational data, account signals, and research into defensible insights and prioritized opportunities.

Differentiate customer symptoms from underlying process, product, service, delivery, or ownership issues and identify cross-functional dependencies.
  
Maintain transparent methodologies, base sizes, assumptions, and limitations so findings can withstand leadership review.

  
  

**Governance and action-plan enablement**

Maintain an integrated view of significant CX actions and outcomes without transferring business ownership to the CX function.

Apply journey-management methods to identify friction, moments that matter, handoff failures, and opportunities for experience redesign.
  
Facilitate cross-functional workshops that move teams from customer evidence to root causes, solution options, and accountable next steps.
  
Strengthen closed-loop practices by connecting customer feedback with action, communication, and measurable follow-through.
  
Partner with global teams to reuse proven solutions and scale regional learning across PCSD and ISG.

Assess the contribution and evidence of impact from CX-enabled changes, recognizing when direct financial attribution is not possible.

You will lead day-to-day delivery of user identity and access lifecycle activities, helping maintain a secure, compliant, and efficient access environment. You will work with client and cross-functional teams to strengthen access governance, operational controls, and service delivery while supporting the development of team members.

**Work you'll do**

As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Lead day-to-day user access administration across applications, platforms, and systems, including provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, access modifications, and joiner, mover, leaver activities.
* Validate access requests for completeness, approvals, and policy alignment; maintain user accounts, group memberships, roles, and entitlements in accordance with approved workflows and service-level targets.
* Oversee the logging, triage, categorization, prioritization, tracking, and closure of incidents, service requests, and access-related tasks using IT service management (ITSM) and ticketing tools.
* Apply standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, knowledge articles, and control requirements; maintain operational documentation, trackers, status updates, and audit evidence for access reviews and recertification activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues, coordinate with application owners, infrastructure, security, and service delivery teams, and escalate complex issues to senior team members or tool administrators within defined thresholds.
* Investigate recurring access issues, entitlement mismatches, control gaps, and workflow exceptions; participate in root-cause discussions and recommend process improvements to strengthen a secure, audit-ready access administration environment.

**The team**

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**

**Qualifications**

Required:

Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

* 10 - 15 years of experience in information technology, service operations, information security support and operational governance with ITIL v4 Service Management Framework.
* 6+ years of experience in access administration, user account management, or IAM operations support.
* Basic hands-on experience with any IAM tool or platform, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, or similar solutions, used for provisioning, deprovisioning, access provisioning, access management, access management or access governance.
* Experience performing manual access administration tasks using documented procedures and approval workflows.
* Working knowledge of user provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, entitlement updates, and access review support.
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or equivalent for managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and operational tracking.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of identity and access management concepts, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, role-based access, least-privilege principles, and access recertification.
* Ability to review requests, follow process controls, and accurately execute operational tasks.
* Experience in maintaining documentation, operational logs, and status reporting.
* Good communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate with appropriate context.

Preferred:

Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:

* Exposure to IAM, IGA, or access management tools.
* Familiarity with access request workflows, approval matrices, and security governance processes.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and policy requirements related to access administration.
* Ability to follow client information security policies and handle sensitive access tasks with accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and process discipline.
* Ability to identify issues early, troubleshoot at a basic level, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic reporting and tracking skills using standard operational tools.
* Exposure to incident/problem management concepts and recurring issue resolution.

Education:

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Industry Health Care

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The company**

TRS / dAIgnostiX provides teleradiology and diagnostic reporting to hospitals and imaging centres in the US and international markets. The company is well funded and aiming for high growth at >25% CAGR. It is investing in the leadership team that will get it there.

**The opportunity**

TRS is set for rapid growth, at a CAGR above 25%. That growth depends on American Board Radiologists (ABRs): the size, deployment and satisfaction (NPS) of the ABR panel is the binding constraint. The panel has about 100 ABRs today, with a substantial increase planned in the coming months.

The ABR journey is split across several teams, including Onboarding, Scheduling and Assigning, and no one owns the ABR's experience end to end. The result is a paradox: the company reports a capacity shortage, while ABRs say they are underused. Part of the capacity gap is really a deployment gap, and closing it is faster than recruiting alone.

This role is the single owner of that journey. You will lead everything that decides whether an ABR is credentialed, scheduled, supported and productive. You will own ABR capacity and productivity, and ABR satisfaction.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Own Radiologist (ABR) capacity and productivity . Be the named owner of ABR utilisation (actual vs. contracted hours), productivity, and the capacity gap against planned revenue. Make these live, per-ABR numbers, not a one-off analysis. Calculate the capacity gap net of utilisation recovery, so recruiting decisions rest on real utilisation rather than an inflated shortage.
* Deploy before you recruit. Run an ABR-by-ABR diagnostic across the full roster, starting with the highest-hours group. Tag a root cause and a named owner for each, and work through the fixes with Operations Delivery, who own case assignment.
* Own the pipeline from offer to first live shift. Recruitment and HR source candidates; you own everything after: offer, licensing and credentialing, orientation and the first live shift. Set a time-to-first-read target and keep bringing it down.
* Credential to match demand. Credential against forecast demand, not whoever is next in the queue. Introduce a rule that each ABR agrees their hospital list before applications start. Set up a live credentialing feed into Scheduling, so a hospital approved on Monday can be scheduled on Tuesday.
* Run ABR experience and engagement. Give every ABR one point of contact and a set rhythm: a weekly pulse, a monthly review and a quarterly plan. Track every concern from intake to closure: acknowledge within 24 hours, and resolve operational and IT issues within 48–72 hours. Set up a real ABR satisfaction measure (an open item in the KPI framework today). Manage no-show rate and annualized attrition as leading indicators, not just reported numbers.
* Shape the ABR proposition: technology, terms and training. Be the ABR's voice wherever their working day is shaped.
* Technology first. Image load, dictation workflow, RADSpa friction and pre-read or AI support are the most common complaints. Sponsor a ranked fix list with the technology team, and a pre-read pilot with volunteer ABRs, measured in RVUs per hour.
* Training. Shape training and onboarding of new and existing ABRs
* Chair the shared ABR-capacity forum. Run forum that brings together scheduling decisions, credentialing status, assignment practice and utilisation data. Keep one shared tracker so every team sees gaps at the same time, and agree a clear escalation path.
* Build the leadership bench. Build a real management layer with succession depth as the roster and volume triple, and give new leaders the structure, tools and coaching to grow.

### **Requirements**

**Candidate profile**

  

* 7–8 years of experience in hospital operations, healthcare administration or clinical operations.
* Strong understanding of hospital operations, healthcare workflows and administrative processes.
* Experience coordinating with doctors, consultants, radiologists or other medical professionals.
* Exposure to workforce planning, scheduling, resource utilisation and operational management.
* Should have experience managing multi-functional hospital operations teams, overseeing day-to-day healthcare operations, coordinating with doctors and medical professionals, and driving operational efficiency.

**Educational Qualification**

  

* Master's degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) or MBA in Hospital Management.
* Candidates with relevant postgraduate qualifications in Healthcare Management may also be considered.
